Excellent Vietnamese food and brilliant host
Nov 2024 • Couples
We popped into this restaurant which was recommended by our tour guide. Simple surroundings but brilliant food. We had spring rolls (wafer thin crust, vegetables inside), prawns with garlic, pork and pineapple (not normally a lover of fruit in savoury dishes but making a BIG exception this time), chicken and rice. The owner is Andy. Really nice guy, speaks excellent English and is a first class host. He also runs cooking classes which is both a testimony to his restaurant’s skill as well as an endorsement of the transparency of how the kitchen is run. Simple restaurant, great value, excellent food. A true delight. A little out of the way but worth a cheap taxi ride or leisurely stroll.

Welcomed with a smile, food was amazing and the surprise touch of a birthday cake
Apr 2024 • Family
My family and I were taken to Chopstick restaurant as part of our tour. We were treated to an amazingly fresh, tasty and scrumptious lunch. 
Alan was such an hospitable host. He was attentive without being intrusive, however we happily asked him to sit and join us for a chat after we had finished eating. 
The best surprise was that with an hours notice, Alan and our tour guide had arranged for a birthday cake for our daughter who was celebrating her 16th birthday that day. Such a sweet gesture to top off an incredible day. 

I cannot recommend Alan and Chopsticks restaurant enough.
